We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to join our AI Engineering team and help design, build, and roll out production-grade AI solutions, with a strong focus on AI engineering, AI agents, agentic workflows, machine learning, GenAI, and LLM-based applications .

This is a senior individual contributor role within the AI Engineering team. The Senior AI Engineer will work closely with the AI Tech Lead , engineering teams, product stakeholders, data teams, cloud/platform teams, and security teams to deliver reliable AI capabilities into real business systems.

The technology stack is diverse and can include Python (FastAPI/Flask/Django) or equivalent frameworks; React on the frontend side, and various ML/AI frameworks, APIs, cloud-native services, along with modern AI tooling .

The role will have a strong focus on AWS , including Amazon Bedrock , Amazon Bedrock AgentCore , Amazon SageMaker , and other AWS AI/ML services.

Responsibilities 

- Design, build, and maintain AI-powered applications, services, and integrations as part of the AI Engineering team.
- Implement solutions focused on AI agents, agentic workflows, automation, LLM-based applications, and AI-assisted business processes .
- Build and integrate AI applications using technologies such as Python (FastAPI/Flask/Django) or equivalent frameworks, React frontends, and relevant AI/ML frameworks .
- Implement AI solutions using AWS AI/ML services , including Amazon Bedrock , Amazon Bedrock AgentCore , Amazon SageMaker , and other AWS services for model hosting, inference, orchestration, data processing, monitoring, and security.
- Work closely with the AI Tech Lead to align on architecture, technology choices, engineering standards, AI patterns, and rollout approaches.
- Provide technical input and guidance to other engineers on AI implementation patterns, code quality, testing, observability, and production readiness.
- Develop and integrate AI agents that interact with internal APIs, business workflows, enterprise systems, knowledge bases, and external tools in a safe and controlled way.
- Build and maintain RAG-based solutions , including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector search, retrieval logic, reranking, and grounding techniques.
- Support the development and deployment of machine learning models and AI solutions into production environments.
- Contribute to ML pipelines and MLOps practices , including data preparation, model training, experiment tracking, model deployment, monitoring, evaluation, and lifecycle management.

title: Stage de fin d'études - Consultant Data & IA H/F - Régions
location: Nantes, Pays de la Loire, France
description:
La mission : 

A travers le stage, vous aurez l'opportunité de mettre en pratique vos compétences, d'apprendre auprès d'experts, et de contribuer à des projets concrets et impactants. 

Être consultant, c’est participer à des projets qui répondent à la fois à des enjeux techniques et à des problématiques orientées business qui concernent des secteurs d’activité variés (luxe, retail, banque/assurance, industrie, etc). 

Nos missions allient une dimension technique et opérationnelle permettant d’approfondir vos connaissances sur des sujets novateurs. Vous interviendrez sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie de la donnée afin de développer et faire vivre les applications data stratégiques de nos clients. Lors de vos projets vous serez amené à travailler sur les éléments suivants : 

- Vous participerez au cadrage du besoin client et à la réflexion sur les méthodologies et architectures à mettre en œuvre pour y apporter des réponses grâce à la Data et à l'IA, 

- Vous identifierez, intégrerez et structurerez les données (sources, connecteurs ETL/ELT, modélisation) pour transformer la donnée brute en indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) exploitables et fiables, 

- Vous réaliserez des analyses approfondies et concevrez des modèles (statistiques, machine learning, algorithmes IA, agentiques) pour répondre à des problématiques complexes (comportement client, prédictif, optimisation), 

- Vous mettrez en valeur vos résultats et industrialiserez vos solutions , en créant des outils de restitution pour les équipes métiers et en appliquant les meilleures pratiques de programmation, 

- Vous ferez preuve d'une forte appétence pour l'écosystème IA , en restant en veille sur les innovations, en expérimentant de nouveaux usages et en développant des briques/solutions IA dès que le sujet s'y prête. 

En fonction de votre appétence et de vos envies, un sujet à dominante technique ou business vous sera confié. 

Ci-dessous des exemples de sujet : 

- Optimisation de la préparation de commande en magasin avec un algorithme d’optimisation sous contrainte, 

- Utilisation de la Gen AI pour extraire des informations depuis des documents PDF et générer des synonymes afin d’améliorer les recherches documentaires, 

- Mise en place d’un score de churn par rayon et par magasin avec utilisation de méthodes de Machine Learning Interprétable, 

- Implémentation d’une segmentation des visites basées sur les données de navigation du site e-commerce , 

- Identifier les magasins à caractère saisonnier en termes de chiffre d’affaires, afin d’ajuster les budgets hebdomadaires et d'optimiser le ciblage des campagnes marketing, 

- Développement d’un dashboard dédié au service du Contrôle de Gestion d’un grand groupe de prêt-à-porter afin d’analyser tous les mois le profil des clients ayant contribué au chiffre d’affaires, 

- Développement d'agents conversationnels (LLM) pour interroger les données de vente et mise en place de cas d'usage IA. 

Lab’ AVISIA : 

En complément de nos missions, nous menons divers projets internes qui alimentent notre recherche et développement . Ces projets nous donnent l'opportunité d'offrir à nos clients des approches analytiques innovantes, testées en grandeur nature. 

Afin de soutenir ces initiatives, nous avons mis en place nos propres infrastructures . Nos consultants bénéficient ainsi des ressources les plus récentes et des dernières solutions du marché pour leur apprentissage, y compris des versions "early adopter" à tester avant leur mise à disposition générale. 

Nos engagements : 

Après avoir mis en place une politique interne solide en termes de RSE, nous avons souhaité mettre nos compétences au service de projets orientés développement durable . Une initiative dédiée est née : AVISIA Impact . 

Cette initiative est ainsi notre réponse pour apporter une contribution directe (via nos projets) et indirecte (via la formation de nos équipes) aux enjeux de transformation durable. Nous voulons ainsi faciliter l’émergence des futurs acteurs de la transformation et accélérer le rythme du changement. 

Pour plus d'information sur ces initiatives data au service de la transformation durable, n'hésitez pas à consulter notre page dédiée Data For Impact . 

L'humain : 

Nous recherchons donc des talents ayant : 

- Ayant un excellent relationnel, 

- Avec la volonté de s'impliquer sur la réussite de projet client, 

- Dotés d’un bon esprit d’analyse et de synthèse, 

- Qui accordent une importance particulière à la qualité des livrables ainsi qu’à la présentation, 

- Curieux et soucieux de se tenir informé des évolutions du marché, 

- Avec l’envie de continuer à apprendre pour être acteur de leur progression. 

Les compétences : 

Vous êtes en dernière année de formation data à l’université ou en grande école et disposez des compétences suivantes : 

- Très bonne connaissance du SQL et Python, 

- Bonne connaissance des principaux algorithmes de machine learning, 

- Capacité à expliquer des concepts complexes de façon simple et pédagogique, 

- Bonne connaissance des outils d'IA générative (Gemini, chatGPT…) et de développement assisté (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code...) pour optimiser son efficacité au quotidien, 

- Petit plus : Vous avez des notions sur les technologies cloud (Ex : Google Cloud Platform, AWS, Azure, Snowflake...) et/ou d’une solution logicielle du marché de traitement et d’analyse de la donnée (Ex : Dataiku, Databricks…)

title: Python and Kubernetes Software Engineer - Data, Workflows, AI/ML & Analytics
description:

Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring Python and Kubernetes Specialist Engineers focused on Data, Workflows, AI/ML and Analytics Solutions to join our teams building open source solutions for public cloud and private infrastructure.

As a software engineer on the team, you'll collaborate on end-to-end data analytics and MLOps solutions composed of popular, open-source, machine learning tools, such as Kubeflow, MLFlow, DVC, and Feast. You may also work on ETL, data governance and visualization tools like Apache SuperSet, dbt, workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow and Temporal, or data warehouse solutions such as Apache Trino, or ClickHouse. These solutions may be run on servers or on the cloud, on machines or on Kubernetes, on developer desktops, or as web services.

We serve the needs of individuals and community members as much as the needs of our Global 2000 and Fortune 500 customers; we make our primary work available free of charge and our Pro subscriptions are also available to individuals for personal use at no cost. Our goal is to enable more people to enjoy the benefits of open source, regardless of their circumstances.

- Master distributed systems concepts such as observability, identity, tracing

- Work with both Kubernetes and machine-oriented open source applications

- Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills

- Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability

- Thoughtfulness and self-motivation 

- Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments 

- Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long

- Experience with container technologies (Docker, LXD, Kubernetes, etc.)

- Experience with public clouds (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)

- Working knowledge of cloud computing

- Passionate about software quality and testing

- Experience working on an open source project

description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We have created a new career path at Canonical for Performance Engineers who bring exceptional clarity to software performance, correctness and efficiency. We are adding these roles to every engineering team at the company.

As an open source platform, we have teams that work at every level of the software stack - from the kernel up through server and desktop applications, all the way to the web. We are adding roles with this focus in every engineering team in the company, to act as drivers of performance engineering skills, tools, culture and insights to our entire product range . We have also created a central performance engineering team, where we will drive shared tools, dashboarding capabilities, measurement frameworks, analytical capabilities and skills. We call this career focus ' percorr ' because we have found that the same deep insights that enable sophisticated performance measurement and design also enable teams to improve their harnesses and frameworks for correctness. Understanding not only the application, but the runtime, the compiler, and the system, all the way down to the CPU, gives an engineer the ability to think creatively and with insight about the right things to measure, and the right ways to verify correctness. We have found that performance engineers will often improve the deepest and trickiest areas of our test harnesses, and unblock their teams to test and measure previously 'dark' aspects of their work.

We also have teams that work with every major silicon vendor and cloud, with a particular emphasis on performance optimisation of the entire stack for that architecture, CPU family or hypervisor. Our goal is to ensure that Ubuntu users can select whatever platform they want for their workloads and know they have access to the very best performance and efficiency across the entire stack from kernel to codec.

If they wish, we will enable performance and correctness engineers to move between products every two years, so that they have the opportunity to raise the bar for performance in an array of products over time, and also that teams have the benefit of fresh eyes on their processes, thinking, harnesses, dashboards and code. Our performance and correctness leads are expected to be truly exceptional individuals, and also leaders who are confident setting expectations of change, sharing insights and skills, running initiatives and programs. There is no way to move a meaningful codebase without also moving the people behind it. 

This is a career path for perfectionists and precision artists. Whether you have a particular language focus - C, C++, Rust, Golang, Python, Java, Flutter-Dart or others - or a particular love of the kernel or hardware or CPU instruction set, whether you see yourself as driving perceived user experience through performance or optimising the efficiency of data centers to reduce carbon footprint, this process is the best way to find a role at Canonical that speaks to your precision, rigour, insight and drive.

- Compiler level performance insights - profile guided optimization, inlining, assembler

Performance Engineer - Benchmarking
description:
About Supabase 

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

About this role

We’re hiring experienced performance engineers to make performance measurement at Supabase rigorous, repeatable, and actionable by product teams. This role owns the benchmarking and profiling systems we use to detect regressions, explain performance changes, and publish credible numbers for customers and the market. You’ll build the tooling and the methodology and make it easy for product teams to use it correctly.

You’d join a new performance team as one of its first members, working alongside a deeply seasoned performance engineer, with the team growing to roughly six this year. There’s no legacy process to inherit — you’ll help define how we measure and communicate performance metrics at Supabase.

What you’ll do

- 
Build and evolve benchmarking, profiling, and load-testing tooling (cloud, database, and end-to-end).

- 
Define benchmark suites and reference workloads that reflect real customer behavior (and evolve them as the products change).

- 
Establish performance baselines and regression gates across products (variance tracking, environment control, and detection of changes).

- 
Build mechanisms that turn benchmark results into action: triage workflows, owner routing, and clear, reproducible reports.

- 
Partner closely with database teams (e.g. Multigres, OrioleDB) to identify bottlenecks and land concrete performance improvements.

- 
Enable the company to publish credible, repeatable performance numbers for customers and the market.

- 
Help teams self-serve performance testing and make performance a first-class engineering concern.

Problems you might work on

- 
Build our continuous benchmarking infrastructure so product teams can spot performance regressions early. Ideally, teams can run benchmarks directly on PRs or locally while developing a feature.

- 
Analyze and eliminate issues with load generators, workloads or benchmark environments to ensure that benchmarks are reliable indicators for actual product performance.

- 
Build regression triage tooling that pinpoints what changed (diffing, profiles/traces, query-level attribution).

- 
Help product teams so they can analyze the root cause of performance regressions in benchmark environments themselves.

What we’re looking for

- 
Deep experience in performance engineering, benchmarking, and profiling of complex distributed systems. Specifically, you have owned benchmarking systems where reproducibility and controlling variance mattered.

- 
Strong systems intuition (databases, storage, networking, cloud infrastructure).

- 
Comfortable working across product, infra, and database teams.

- 
Pragmatic, tooling-oriented mindset with strong communication skills.

- 
Depth on at least one end of that stack: Linux kernel internals (virtual memory, scheduling, networking, IO) or database internals (query planning, storage engines, buffer and WAL management)

What We Offer 

- 
Fully Remote 

We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

- 
ESOP 

Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

- 
Tech Allowance 

Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

- 
Health Benefits 

Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

- 
Annual Off-Sites 

Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

- 
Flexible Work 

We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

- 
Professional Development 

Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team 

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

- 
~400 team members

- 
60+ countries

- 
20+ languages spoken

- 
Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

- 
540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

Data Analyst, Supply 

Prolific 

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are the architects of the human data infrastructure that's reshaping the landscape of AI development. In a world where foundational AI technologies are increasingly commoditised, it's the quality and diversity of human-generated data that truly differentiates products and models. 

T he role 

As Prolific scales, maintaining a healthy and sustainable participant marketplace will be critical to our ability to meet growing demand for high-quality human data. This role will own analytics across the participant lifecycle, from acquisition and onboarding through activation, engagement, quality, retention, and reactivation. 

You’ll build the metrics, dashboards, and experimentation frameworks that help us understand participant behaviour and improve the participant experience. You’ll work closely with Product, Operations, Growth, and Data Science to identify opportunities, structure experiments, and turn complex marketplace data into clear decisions. 

Working hands-on across SQL, Python, experimentation, and stakeholder conversations, you’ll create clarity around participant health, marketplace liquidity, and long-term supply sustainability. 

What you’ll bring to the role 

- Analytics Expertise: Advanced SQL and strong Python proficiency (e.g. pandas, experimentation analysis, automation), with a track record of building scalable reporting frameworks in modern BI tools (Metabase, Looker, Tableau). Comfortable owning problems end-to-end — from raw data to executive-ready insight. 

- Lifecycle Analytics: Experience analysing user acquisition, onboarding, activation, engagement, retention, churn, and behavioural cohorts. 

- Experimentation & Statistics: Experience designing and analysing A/B or operational experiments, with solid grounding in statistical concepts and causal thinking. 

- Product Thinking: Ability to translate participant and marketplace challenges into measurable hypotheses, success metrics, and actionable recommendations. 

- Commercial Acumen: Strong ability to connect operational metrics to revenue, margin, and financial performance — understanding not just what is happening, but why it matters commercially. 

- Autonomy & Ownership: Comfortable operating with high autonomy in a fast-moving environment, setting priorities, challenging assumptions, and driving initiatives from problem definition through implementation. 

- Stakeholder Management: Proven ability to partner across Product, Operations, Commercial, and Finance functions. 

- Marketplace Understanding: Strong grasp of B2B and two-sided marketplace metrics and economics. 

- Clear Communication: Ability to translate complex analysis into concise, decision-ready insights that shape strategy and execution. 

Why Prolific is a great place to work 

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioural data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems. 

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviours into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breath and the best of humanity.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Payments
description:
About Airwallex 

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

How you'll make impact

You’ll define the technical direction for Airwallex’s Payments Platform, lead architecture decisions and build highly reliable, high-volume distributed systems that directly affect merchant experience and business outcomes.

You’ll design and build scalable backend services, REST APIs, event-driven systems and integration components within a microservices architecture, connecting with our React frontend. You’ll drive complex initiatives across payment gateways, acquiring, issuing, card networks and local payment methods, while partnering with product, business, infrastructure and external engineering teams to turn merchant needs into technical solutions.

You’ll raise the engineering bar through architectural reviews, thoughtful approaches to technical debt, strong design practices, code quality, testing, observability, reliability and mentorship.

What we're looking for

Essentials 

- 10+ years of software engineering experience, including Staff-level technical leadership or equivalent ownership of complex backend systems.

- Strong experience designing and operating high-volume distributed systems, preferably in payments, fintech, commerce or financial infrastructure.

- Recent hands-on experience with Java or Kotlin and Spring or Spring Boot.

- Expert experience building REST APIs, backend microservices, Kafka-based event streams and distributed data stores such as Cassandra, Hazelcast, Oracle Coherence or similar.

- Experience with cloud platforms such as GCP or AWS, plus Docker and Kubernetes.

- Strong familiarity with observability and operational tooling such as New Relic, StatsD, ELK, Datadog, Prometheus or similar.

- A proven ability to lead projects from concept to production, with a focus on quality, testing, reliability and maintainability.

- Excellent communication skills and the ability to influence across engineering, product and business stakeholders.

Preferred 

- Experience building payment gateways, acquiring platforms, issuing platforms or payment acceptance infrastructure.

- Experience integrating major card networks such as Visa and Mastercard.

- Experience with local payment methods such as iDEAL, Klarna, Trustly or similar.

- Familiarity with authorisation, capture, refunds, chargebacks, settlement, reconciliation, fraud, risk or PCI/compliance workflows.

- Experience mentoring senior engineers and leading cross-team technical initiatives.

You'll thrive here if

- You’re comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.

- You own the outcome and you don’t wait for permission to fix what’s broken.

- You’re comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you’ll run with it.

- You communicate clearly and directly across cultures, and you’re thoughtful about how context shifts meaning across borders.

- You’re comfortable operating across time zones with a globally distributed team, including colleagues based in APAC and EMEA.

Learn more about your team

Payments Platform at Airwallex builds the infrastructure that turns global payment complexity into reliable, scalable payment experiences, helping businesses accept and process money across markets with less friction. The challenge is balancing performance, reliability, local complexity, and commercial outcomes in the same system, where small improvements can materially affect conversion and failures are immediately visible. You'll do well here if you're thoughtful, pragmatic, and motivated by making complex problems feel simple to customers. If you want to build the platform that makes payments work seamlessly for businesses around the world, this is the team at the center of that mission.

Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

title: Senior Control Systems Engineer
description:
Fusionality is building the measurement, simulation and control stack of the fusion energy reactors of the future.

Our technology enables effective and reliable operation, monitoring, and analysis of high-temperature plasmas in fusion devices — which will one day provide clean, practically limitless power to the grid. We have spun out of EPFL’s Swiss Plasma Center and have just completed our pre-seed fundraise.

We are looking for a Senior Control Systems Engineer to join our founding team in Lausanne and help build our core technology.

This job is for you if you are a passionate engineer with deep knowledge cutting across real-time / embedded systems, software and hardware, and excited about building the systems to monitor and control real-world fusion plasmas.

Tasks

- Implement real-time control, analysis, data acquisition systems in the kHz to MHz range, as individual contributor and in a team.

- Integrate solutions across a variety of company products and services as well as on our in-house test beds.

- Provide technical leadership within a growing real-time control and software engineering team that you will help to build.

- Translate customer needs into requirements and specifications.

Requirements

- Experience taking hard-real-time acquisition and control loops from incomplete requirements through to commissioning on hardware, in domains such as automotive, robotics, embedded, electrical and/or scientific instrumentation.

- ‘Full stack’: familiarity with all aspects of real-time technologies, from physical/DAQ, real-time software frameworks and middleware, real-time OS and integration.

- Fluency in a mix of high-level and low-level languages such as C, C++, Rust, MATLAB/Simulink, Python. Obsession with code quality, testing and reliability.

- Experience with distributed real-time systems, real-time networking and field buses and/or SCADA is an advantage.

- Experience with embedded/μC/FPGA technologies and/or safety critical systems is an advantage.

Benefits

- The unique opportunity to play a foundational role at a dynamic, fast-growing startup, shaping the technical solutions and products from the ground up.

title: AI Experience Engineer (Conversational AI)
description:
Headquarters: Canada (Remote)

About the Role: 

An AI Experience Engineer owns the full lifecycle of the journeys our customers have with Upgrade's AI agent on chat, voice and email: creation, optimization, edge case handling and containment growth. They build journeys in Sierra's no-code tooling, partner with Upgrade's product groups to bring their servicing flows to the agent, and are accountable for whether the agent resolves the customer's issue safely, accurately and without a human. 

We are hiring an AI Experience Engineer to own Upgrade's customer-facing AI agent. You will sit between engineering, product and customer operations. You will turn servicing workflows, such as making a payment, checking loan details, updating an address or enabling autopay, into production journeys and keep improving them after launch. You will build and own the journeys end to end, from first draft to steady state. The work is part builder, part analyst: design the flow, handle the edge cases, read the transcripts, and keep raising containment. Containment, CSAT, transfer quality and hallucination rate are your metrics. 

Within your first year, you will own a portfolio of journeys across products (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, HELOC, Deposits) and help set the standards for how Upgrade builds, tests and ships AI experiences. 

Our Core Technologies 

Sierra Agent Studio (no-code journeys), Sierra simulations and conversation analytics, GraphQL and REST APIs (as journey tools), Genesys (contact center handoff), SumoLogic, Grafana, SQL, Javascript/Typescript, Claude and other LLM tools. 

What You'll Do 

• Journey creation: Design and build Sierra journeys in Agent Studio for chat, voice and email, from discovery with operations through production rollout 

• Optimization: Review transcripts, recordings and analytics every week, find where conversations fail or transfer, and ship fixes to journey logic, instructions and knowledge 

• Edge case handling: Map the unhappy paths (failed payments, mismatched identity, delinquent accounts, unsupported requests) and make sure each ends in a correct answer or a clean handoff 

• Containment: Own containment and CSAT targets per journey, run staged rollouts (1% → 100%), and prioritize the work that moves those numbers most 

• Product partnership: Work with product groups (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, Deposits) to scope new journeys, keep journeys current as products change, and define the APIs the agent needs 

• Safety and compliance: Apply tiered authentication and step-up verification, verbatim compliance language and guardrails against hallucination and off-policy answers 

• Handoffs: Design transfers to human agents in Genesys with accurate summaries and auth context 

• Testing: Build simulation and regression suites so every journey change ships with evidence it did not break existing behavior 

• Monitoring: Watch latency, errors and drop-offs in SumoLogic and Grafana, and own the alerts 

• Voice tuning: Latency, filler phrases, interruptions, personality and tone 

• Sierra relationship: Be the technical owner on our side, escalate platform issues and shape roadmap asks 

What We Look For: 

• 3–5 years of Frontend Software Engineering experience, or equivalent experience in Solutions Engineering, Conversational AI or Technical Product roles 

• Working knowledge of how LLM agents behave: instructions, tool calls, knowledge retrieval, and where each one fails 

• Experience building evaluations for non-deterministic systems: test sets, simulations, LLM-as-judge, regression gates 

• Enough technical depth to read API specs, work with backend engineers on REST and GraphQL integrations, and reason about authorization and permission scopes 

• Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, with the ability to build and maintain coded journeys and integrate APIs within conversational AI platforms. 

• Product and customer mindset: you understand ops procedures, you read transcripts, care about tone, and measure success by whether the customer's problem got solved 

• Ownership in production: rollouts, monitoring, log analysis and incident response 

• Clear writing and the ability to work with non-engineers in operations, compliance and legal 

Nice To Have: 

• Hands-on experience with Sierra Agent Studio, or a comparable no-code agent platform (Decagon, Ada, Kore.ai, Google CCAI, Amazon Lex/Connect) 

• Voice AI experience: speech-to-text, text-to-speech, latency tuning, barge-in handling 

• Contact center systems such as Genesys, and agent handoff design 

• Background in fintech or another regulated industry (UDAAP, FDCPA, TCPA, PCI, SOC 2) 

• Conversation design or UX writing experience 

What We Offer You: 

• Competitive salary ($140K-$180K CAN) and stock option plan 

• Paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance 

• Flexible PTO 

• Opportunities for professional growth and development
• Paid parental leave 

• Health & wellness initiatives

title: Software Engineer, Backend
description:
Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments. 

We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.

We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.

Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.

We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.

About the role

You’ll build backend systems that make our lab programmable. You'll architect data pipelines that process large-scale protein characterization data, build APIs that integrate laboratory instruments and robotics into our software stack, and work closely with scientists and automation engineers to translate complex molecular biology workflows into reliable, scalable software. This is not SaaS slop, you're making physical machines do precise biology with minimal human intervention.

What we're looking for 

- Strong experience designing and building production backend systems. We use Python and TypeScript on the backend with Postgres, but what matters is that you can architect systems that are reliable and maintainable.

- Experience building data pipelines and processing infrastructure. You'll be handling large volumes of heterogeneous data from physical instruments such as binding kinetics data, enzyme activity measurements, chromatography readings, and turning them into clean, structured datasets.

- Comfortable with API design and systems integration. A big part of this role is making hardware talk to software: connecting instruments, robotics, and scheduling systems into a coherent whole.

- A genuine interest in biology. No background required, but our product is running biology experiments in the physical world and that should excite you.

- High-autonomy, founder mindset. We share context and vision openly. You figure out what matters most and go work on it.

- Pragmatism. You care about solving the problem well, not about the stack or the tools.

- You write code primarily with AI, but you have enough experience writing software without it to know what good code and good architecture look like.

We are reviewing applicants on a rolling basis.

title: International Expansion

At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, inverters and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel. Read more about what we’re building here .

We’re looking for a commercially sharp, highly autonomous operator to drive Axle’s commercial success in the Dutch market. 

Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach internationally. Our goal is to become the go-to platform for energy flexibility globally, and we’re hiring the person to make that happen.

This role will assess Axle’s participation in Dutch markets and business models from first principles: diving deep into regulations, modelling revenue-per-asset, and trialling new propositions at pace.

You speak Dutch and fluent English. Other European languages will also be an asset.

What you will be doing 

- Owning new customer acquisition end-to-end, from first conversation through to commercial close, setting our partners up to generate meaningful revenue.

- High-level strategy development, defining and executing Axle’s international expansion plans, and assessing the commercial value of Dutch markets and business models.

- Diving deep into policy and regulations, understanding how market access works and what needs doing to achieve it.

- Developing the zero-to-one of the business through partnerships with key stakeholders. You’ll be jumping on the phone (and eventually, getting on the ground) with grid operators, utilities/retailers and potential clients to create and disprove hypotheses as quickly as possible.

We are looking for people who have built things, developed new relationships, and helped get big projects over the line in complex environments.

This is an opportunity to repeatedly deliver first-of-a-kind projects across the world, become a domain expert, and work at the bleeding edge of global electrification.

What’s in it for you

This is a 12 month fixed-term contract. Compensation is highly competitive and dependent on experience.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

title: GTM Enablement - Partner Program
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role 

As a Partner Enablement Program Manager, you'll build and run the ElevenLabs partner academy for systems integrators, hyperscalers and technology partners. You'll create curricula across sales, pre-sales and technical implementation, starting with ElevenAgents and expanding across ElevenCreative and ElevenAPI. You'll work closely with our regional Forward Deployed Engineers, who bring the technical expertise and set the technical quality bar. Your mission is to grow the program to 10,000+ certified partner professionals by the end of 2027, and to make the ElevenLabs certification a credential the tech ecosystem respects.

As a Partner Enablement Program Manager, you can expect to:

- Build curricula for partner sellers, pre-sales and implementation engineers: courses, hands-on labs and assessments.

- Turn expert knowledge from our FDEs, sales and product teams into a world-class online academy.

- Run the certification program end to end, from submissions and review workflows to certificates, with FDEs making the technical call.

- Scale the program through automation, from automated agent review to bots and emails that support learners.

- Deliver training online and in person, including sales and technical sessions at our partner hackathons.

- Run program administration: the learning platform, partner onboarding tracks, reporting and learner feedback.

Requirements 

We're looking for an enablement builder who is comfortable with both commercial and technical topics. You don't need to be the deepest expert in the room, but you need enough depth to work with senior engineers and sellers as subject matter experts and turn their knowledge into great learning. You'll thrive with us if you:

- Are passionate about AI, technology and ElevenLabs products.

- Have built enablement or training programs at scale for partners, sellers or technical teams.

- Learn technical products quickly and can explain them to both technical and commercial audiences.

- Can run a program end to end: learning platforms, timelines, stakeholders and reporting.

- Can lead a session or workshop in front of sellers and engineers.

- Have strong instructional design skills: you can turn expert content into clear courses, labs and assessments.

- Enjoy turning repeat work into automations, tools and agents.

- Have excellent communication skills and can adapt your message to different audiences.

Bonus: 

- Experience as a forward deployed engineer, solutions engineer or in professional services for a frontier AI product.

- Hands-on experience building LLM applications or voice and chat agents, and reviewing whether they are ready for production.

- Familiarity with Python or TypeScript, APIs, webhooks and common integration patterns.

- Telephony experience, such as SIP, Twilio or contact center platforms.

- Experience at a systems integrator, hyperscaler or technology partner.

- Experience with learning platforms such as WorkRamp.

- Proficient in Spanish or Portuguese.

Growth Potential 

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

- Leading a partner enablement team as the academy grows.

- Moving into partner program leadership or Solutions Engineering.

Location 

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in North America, with the ability to operate in Americas timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in New York or San Francisco.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

- You have the ability to translate high-level, ambiguous client needs into actionable data science requirements and mathematical frameworks.

- You promote a culture of shared best practices, ensuring all AI development is transparent, ethical, and held to high peer-reviewed standards.

- You are a clear communicator who can manage technical discussions with customers and articulate project feasibility and delivery timelines.

- Take Home Technical Assessment

- Technical Interview (90 minutes)

title: Data/ML engineer, fusion data
description:
Fusionality is building the measurement, simulation, and control stack for the fusion energy reactors of the future.

Spun out of EPFL’s Swiss Plasma Center and backed by top investors, our technology enables reliable operation, real-time monitoring, and analysis of high-temperature plasmas in fusion devices. We are founded by world-class experts at the intersection of fusion physics, advanced control, and AI (ex-Google DeepMind, EPFL). We are assembling a founding engineering team in Lausanne to build our core technology platform.

We are looking for a Data / Machine Learning Engineer to join our team. This job is for you if you like turning large, messy, heterogeneous experimental data into clean, labelled, trustworthy datasets. You have done this with scientific or industrial sensor data. Familiarity with fusion is a plus but not a strict requirement.

Responsibilities

- Build, maintain and run pipelines that bring experimental fusion data into high quality, consistent, documented, versioned datasets.

- Develop ML-assisted labelling and event detection (e.g. disruptions, MHD activity, diagnostic faults), using weak supervision, active learning and anomaly detection.

- Own data quality and provisioning: provenance, calibration metadata, automated validation. Manage and facilitate access for the rest of the team.

- Work with physicists validating the datasets & labels.

- Work with our computational scientists and control engineers, who build models and controllers on these datasets, and with customers to understand and integrate their data.

Requirements

- Hands-on experience building data pipelines for large scientific or industrial time-series data formats (e.g. HDF5, Parquet, Zarr).

- Proficiency in designing, querying and optimizing SQL and noSQL database systems and familiarity with Time Series databases such as TimescaleDB, InfluxDB.

- Experience in applying ML techniques to time series in Python (PyTorch or JAX): sequence models, anomaly and event detection, semi- or weakly-supervised labelling.

- Solid software engineering habits: testing, reproducibility, data versioning are second nature to you.

- Evidence of independent work at the highest level: a PhD thesis and/or published code that is used by others, or an industry project you owned. You should be comfortable designing data architectures independently from day 1.

- The following are an advantage but not strictly required:

- Human-in-the-loop labelling tools and workflows.

- Pipeline Orchestration (e.g. Dagster, Airflow, Prefect) and data versioning (e.g. DVC, lakeFS).

- Data from large physics experiments: fusion, accelerators, astronomy, or exposure to fusion data systems (MDSplus, IMAS).

What we offer

- Play a key role at a dynamic, fast-growing startup, shaping the technical solutions and products from the ground up.

- Build cutting edge technology to monitor and control plasmas in real fusion devices, working side-by-side with leading plasma and control experts.

- Great working conditions, located in Lausanne, Switzerland, a city and country known for its high quality of life.

- Competitive salary and equity compensation, matched to level of seniority, and benefits including immigration assistance.

title: Growth & AI Marketing Operations Specialist
description:
About Papers

Papers AG is a Swiss cyber security engineering house and an incubator for our product portfolio. We build device-level alternatives to centralized cloud and trust. Our strategy is to grow our foundational decentralized network by building high-demand enterprise products directly on top of it.

Your portfolio includes:

- Acurast: Decentralized confidential compute running on ordinary smartphones.

- Obsidio: A continuous, AI-assisted pentesting subscription. Incubated by Papers, Obsidio is built directly on Acurast, leveraging the decentralized network as a unique compute moat to battle-test networks.

- Hypergate: Enterprise mobile single sign-on for managed Android and iOS fleets.

As an engineering-driven team, we work with autonomy and purpose. Our culture is built on meritocracy, long-term thinking, and a commitment to quality over buzz, innovation is in our DNA. We aim to collaborate with people who love tech for its own sake and want to help shape the future by solving real-world challenges.

Your role

We are seeking a tech-savvy, execution-oriented Growth & AI Marketing Operations Specialist to serve as the engine powering our growth campaigns, content infrastructure, and data analytics pipeline.

Your main goal will be to communicate our stories across a portfolio of brands by bridging the gap between cutting-edge AI, data operations, and tactical growth marketing. You’ll be building automated content workflows, ensuring the highest quality across everything we generate, running multi-channel campaigns from start to finish, and maintaining rock-solid attribution tracking.

If you are obsessed with efficiency, operational speed, and using AI to scale output without ever sacrificing quality and if you thrive when given a blank slate to write your own playbook, this role is for you.

Success Metrics (First 90 Days) 

- 30 Days: Take full ownership of the existing marketing tech stack and establish baseline performance metrics.

- 60 Days: Fully automate the core content generation pipeline and establish QA workflows.

- 90 Days: Launch at least two multi-channel growth experiments and demonstrate a measurable reduction in CAC or an increase in content throughput.

Core Responsibilities 

1. Storytelling That Converts 

- Making Complexity Clear: Take complex, often highly technical capabilities and features and turn them into clear, digestible stories without losing accuracy.

- Audience-First Messaging: Understand who the campaigns speak to (developers, technical decision-makers, business stakeholders or end users) and frame each capability around what that audience cares about, at the right level of technical depth.

- Spark Curiosity & Action: Craft narratives that get audiences interested and excited, and that move them to the desired conversion.

- Product & Engineering Collaboration: Work closely with product and engineering teams to deeply understand what is being built, so every story is both compelling and technically correct.

2. Tactical Deployment & Agile Execution 

- Multi-Channel Campaign Launch: Execute and launch integrated campaigns across communities, social channels, search, newsletters, loyalty programs, influencers, paid ads and landing pages. Where needed, bring in and coordinate additional third parties to support execution, such as external PR firms and campaign support providers.

- Marketing Automation: Maintain and scale lifecycle workflows, lead scoring mechanisms, drip sequences, and automated triggers to optimize lead conversion through the relevant funnel.

- Rapid A/B & Multivariate Testing: Design, set up, and evaluate rapid growth experiments (copy variants, landing page layouts, audience segmentation, offer positioning) on a weekly sprint cycle.

3. AI Pipeline Operation & Content QA 

- Automated Workflow Orchestration: Build, maintain, and optimize AI-driven content pipelines to generate high-quality marketing assets at scale.

- Human-in-the-Loop Quality Assurance: Establish strict QA processes to review, refine, and approve AI-generated copy, visual assets, landing page content, and email sequences before deployment.

- Prompt Engineering & Template Optimization: Continuously iterate on, standardize, and version-control skills, design systems and context workflows to ensure output matches brand voice, compliance standards, and conversion best practices.

- Scale & Efficiency Metrics: Track content throughput, error rates, and time-to-market reduction, driving continuous improvement in pipeline efficiency.

4. Analytics, Attribution & Data Ops 

- Tracking Infrastructure: Implementation and maintenance of event tracking, pixel setups, UTM parameters, and server-side tracking across all digital properties.

- Attribution Modeling: Own multi-touch attribution models to accurately trace pipeline generation, conversions, and revenue back to specific campaigns, channels, and AI-driven experiments.

- Data Integrity & Governance: Regularly audit marketing data across CRMs, marketing automation platforms, and internal databases to clean anomalies and maintain a single source of truth.

- Performance Reporting: Build and manage real-time dashboards providing actionable insights into CAC, LTV, conversion rates, and ROI across experiments.

What We Are Looking For 

Essential Experience & Qualifications 

- 3–5+ Years in Growth/Marketing Operations: Proven track record in a fast-paced B2B or B2C growth environment, managing campaign ops, marketing automation, and technical data pipelines.

- Passionate Builder: You deeply identify with our products. We are a fast-moving, mission-driven team, and this role requires intrinsic dedication rather than a standard 9-to-5 mentality.

- Hands-on AI Tooling Expertise: Demonstrated experience applying modern LLMs and generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, Higgsfield) into real-world marketing workflows, beyond simple basic prompts.

- Technical Analytics Proficiency: Deep hands-on experience with Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and data visualization tools.

- Automation Skills: Proficiency with automation platforms to connect API endpoints and pass payload data reliably.

- CRM & Automation Platforms: Direct administration experience with platforms like Zoho.

Preferred Technical Skills 

- Basic technical understanding of Python, JavaScript, HTML/CSS for lightweight API scripting, data manipulation and rapid landing page iterations

Mindset & Soft Skills 

- Systems Thinking: Ability to map out complex, multi-step processes and translate business requirements into efficient technical architecture.

- Agile Adaptability: Comfort operating in fast-paced sprint cycles with changing priorities and a bias toward continuous shipping and learning.

- Obsessive Attention to Detail: An eagle eye for QA; AI speeds up production, but your judgment ensures quality control and brand alignment.

Working Environment & Expectations 

- Execution Velocity: We prioritize shipping experiments quickly, learning from real-world data, and iterating fast.

- Tooling Ownership & Independence: You will have complete autonomy over our stack. We expect you to proactively recommend and implement the best modern automation and AI solutions. You define the tools you need to win.

- Asynchronous Communication: Clear documentation, meticulous task tracking, and transparent status updates are core to how we work, allowing you to manage your own time effectively.

Why join Papers? 

- Work with cutting-edge technology that actually matters with a team that is obsessed with redefining what cutting edge means.

- High ownership, low bureaucracy. Your voice drives the strategy, giving you the independence to define your own processes.

- Influence the Growth strategy from day one.

- Competitive compensation structure tied directly to your impact, with clear pathways for career growth.

- 25 days paid vacation per year.

- Regular team events and retreats (at least quarterly).

- Support for your ongoing learning and development.r

title: Associate Implementation Consultant
description:
Unleash AI Innovators, Securely 

Software is being rewritten in real time. AI agents are starting to write more code than humans do, at a speed no security team has ever had to match, and that single shift is opening up the biggest opportunity our industry has seen in a decade. We're not bracing for it, we're building the company that owns it.

Snyk is building the next generation security platform where security isn't a set of tools people operate. It's a team of security agents working alongside your engineers, finding, fixing, and governing risk at the speed software is now built. These agents work alongside both the company build and the agents they adopt. Security stops being a queue of work waiting for people, and becomes a coordinated workforce companies direct and trust.

Job Summary 

Snyk is hiring an Associate Implementation Consultant to help enterprise customers get started with the Snyk platform after the sale. You will support and deliver onboarding engagements, working with customer development and security teams to configure Snyk across their SDLC, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud infrastructure. This is an early-career role for someone with a technical foundation who wants to build a career in customer-facing application security, with hands-on work from your first weeks and structured coaching from experienced consultants along the way.

About the Team 

The Customer Solutions team owns the technical success of Snyk's customers after the deal closes, from first onboarding session through full platform adoption. Implementation Consultants work alongside Technical Success, Support, Sales, and Product to turn a customer's security goals into a deployed, measurable program. As Snyk's install base continues to grow, this team is expanding to keep delivering a world-class onboarding experience at scale.

What You’ll Do 

- Deliver onboarding engagements for customers with well-defined requirements, following Snyk's onboarding methodology from kick-off through closure.

- Support senior consultants on larger and more complex implementations, taking ownership of defined workstreams and learning how enterprise rollouts are planned and run.

- Configure and integrate the Snyk platform with customer source control, CI/CD, container, and cloud environments, working from documented procedures and escalating questions early.

- Join customer kick-offs, working sessions, and status reviews, and keep customer contacts informed on progress and next steps.

- Answer customer questions about how Snyk works, and bring in senior consultants, Support, or Product when an issue needs deeper expertise.

- Keep accurate project plans, notes, and handoff documentation so every engagement is easy for others to pick up.

- Use Snyk's onboarding playbooks and templates, and suggest improvements when you find gaps.

- Troubleshoot common integration and configuration issues, and document what you learn for the rest of the team.

- Help customer teams understand developer-first security practices so they keep using Snyk after onboarding ends.

- Build your skills through regular coaching, shadowing, and Snyk's technical training and certification programs.

- 

What you’ll bring 

- 1+ years in technical consulting, professional services, technical support, or another customer-facing technical role, or equivalent hands-on experience such as an internship or relevant projects.

- Foundational knowledge of the SDLC and modern DevOps practices, and curiosity about where security fits into both.

- Familiarity with CI/CD and DevOps tooling (for example Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab, Azure DevOps, Kubernetes), with the motivation to go deeper.

- Ability to manage your own tasks and deadlines across more than one customer project, with support from your team.

- The ability to explain technical topics clearly to developers and other technical contacts, in writing and in conversation.

- Genuine interest in application security and belief that a developer-first approach is the right way to solve it.

- A collaborative, customer-first approach and a willingness to ask questions, take feedback, and learn quickly.

- Working fluency with AI-assisted tools (Claude, Gemini, or similar) and comfort with how AI-generated code is changing what customers need to secure.

- Strong written and verbal communication, plus an organized approach to problem solving.

- Nice to have: basic proficiency in a scripting language such as Python, JavaScript, or another modern language.

- Nice to have: prior experience in a support, solutions engineering, or technical account role for AppSec, CI, or DevSecOps products.

- Nice to have: a security certification such as Security+, CSSLP, or CEH.

- Nice to have: a Project Management Professional (PMP) or CAPM certification, or equivalent project management coursework.

- Nice to have: a Computer Science degree or equivalent programming background, and exposure to enterprise-scale web technologies and microservices.

About Snyk 

Snyk is committed to creating an inclusive and engaging environment where our employees can thrive as we rally behind our common mission to make the digital world a safer place. From Snyk employee resource groups, to global benefits that help our employees prioritize their health, wellness, financial security, and a work/life blend, we aim to support our employees along their entire journeys here at Snyk.

Equal Employment Opportunity

title: Supalite Engineer
description:
About Supabase 

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

About the Role 

We're looking for engineers to join the team building Spark, a lightweight implementation of Supabase written in Rust. It runs on an embedded SQLite-based engine with a Postgres-compatible SQL layer, and ships a PostgREST and Auth compatible API, so applications written against @supabase/supabase-js work as-is. It exists because AI builders and platform partners need a database they can give to every prototype without the cost or the wait: sub-second provisioning, a footprint small enough to run inside a sandbox, and an upgrade path to full Supabase when an app graduates to production.

This is a role with a lot of agency. Small team, working product, patterns still to be set. You'll own large areas end to end and make real decisions from day one.

What You'll Be Responsible For 

In this role, you'll:

- 
Grow API compatibility with the Supabase client, keeping behavior faithful to hosted Supabase and backed by conformance tests

- 
Bring more of the Supabase stack to Turso/SQLite

- 
Find and work around gaps in the underlying database engine, with minimal repros and tests

- 
Build and harden the path for upgrading a project from Spark to full Supabase

- 
Own the developer experience end to end: the CLI, local tooling, and docs

- 
Build and harden the hosted offering while keeping the low cost structure in mind, kept loosely coupled so the implementation can be swapped without a rewrite

- 
Work directly with design partners and turn real-world migration and integration friction into a sharper product

- 
Engage with the open-source community and contribute back to the broader Supabase stack

You Might Be a Good Fit If You

- 
Have substantial backend or full-stack experience with strong fluency in Rust, have shipped production Rust, and have built or contributed to a backend system, framework, or developer platform before

- 
Are a strong generalist, comfortable moving across the stack from API design to storage internals to infrastructure, and picking up whatever the problem needs

- 
Read unfamiliar code without friction. A lot of the work means studying reference implementations in other languages, such as GoTrue in Go, PostgREST in Haskell, and matching their behavior in Rust

- 
Have a solid grounding in SQL and relational databases, experience working close to a database engine (transactions, MVCC, type systems), and the curiosity to dig into where Postgres and SQLite differ

- 
Know Postgres well enough to use it as the reference for correct behavior

- 
Have run services under tight resource limits (multi-tenant, serverless, or embedded)

- 
Have a bias toward compatibility and correctness, and reach for tests and specs to prove behavior

- 
Think around corners. When everyone reaches for the standard playbook, you look for the simpler path that fits a smaller box. You break a complex system down to the 20% that covers 80% of the need, then make it run somewhere far smaller than it was designed for

- 
Care about developer experience: clean APIs, fast feedback loops, and tooling that makes the right thing the easy thing

- 
Are comfortable owning ambiguous, early-stage work and making sound calls that inform and define the spec. This is a founding role on a brand-new team

- 
Are comfortable working in public repositories on a remote, async team

- 
Communicate clearly in writing

- 
Bonus: experience with the Supabase stack, building developer CLIs, a track record of open-source maintenance, or contributions to Rust database or web projects

What We Offer 

- 
Fully Remote 

We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

- 
ESOP 

Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

- 
Tech Allowance 

Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

- 
Health Benefits 

Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

- 
Annual Off-Sites 

Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

- 
Flexible Work 

We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

- 
Professional Development 

Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team 

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

- 
~400 team members

- 
60+ countries

- 
20+ languages spoken

- 
Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

- 
540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Blockchain Risk Control Lead
description:
Headquarters: Europe - Remote

About Us 

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.

Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

Job Brief

We are expanding our focus to cover AI-augmented threat intelligence and post-quantum cryptographic (PQC) security. The ideal candidate will combine deep blockchain forensics expertise with working knowledge of machine learning techniques for anomaly detection, and awareness of quantum computing threats to current cryptographic foundations (ECDSA, RSA) used across blockchain ecosystems. We value candidates who can bridge academia and industry and build collaborative relationships with research institutions to accelerate the adoption of emerging cryptographic and AI-driven techniques within the company.

Main Responsibilities of a Blockchain Risk Control Analyst/Researcher

Your main responsibilities will include:

- 
Leveraging LLM techniques to drive the development of next-generation on-chain risk identification and threat intelligence systems, including autonomous agent workflows capable of continuous monitoring, self-triggered investigation, and automated operational responses — reducing manual intervention across the full risk lifecycle from detection to resolution;

- 
Leading forensic investigations on real crypto theft, fraud, and market manipulation cases, integrating AI-assisted pattern recognition to accelerate root cause analysis;

- 
Researching post-quantum cryptographic algorithms (NIST PQC: ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, FALCON) and their implications for blockchain security; assessing quantum computing threats to existing cryptographic foundations (ECDSA secp256k1, hash functions) and evaluating migration paths;

- 
Partnering with internal teams and external stakeholders for incident response, and engaging with academic institutions to translate frontier research into deployable security tools;

Key Requirements

- 
You have a Master's or PhD's degree in Blockchain security, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field.

- 
You are good at programming languages commonly used in blockchain analytics (e.g., SQL, Python, Javascript)

- 
Experience applying machine learning or AI techniques to blockchain data analysis, fraud detection, or threat intelligence

- 
A strong publication record in top-level industry or academic conferences is highly valued.

- 
You have experience with blockchain monitoring/forensic tools and analytics platforms.

- 
Familiarity with NIST PQC standards (ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, FALCON) and lattice/hash-based cryptography fundamentals is a plus;

- 
Understanding of quantum computing threats to elliptic curve cryptography and implications for key management in Web3;

- 
You have security or risk control experience as a plus.

- 
You possess effective communication and collaboration abilities.

- 
English is essential, and proficiency in Mandarin can be an advantage.

Why Join Us 
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. 
Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

title: Lead Linux Kernel Engineer - Ubuntu

Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

The Canonical Kernel Team is seeking exceptionally talented technology experts and industry veterans with a proven track record in operating systems kernel development or low level system engineering to take the lead in the architecture, implementation, and ongoing delivery of the following (but not limited to) aspects of the Ubuntu Linux kernel:

- Driving engagements for key Silicon and Cloud partners to provide optimal solutions for their platforms

- Leading the mitigation of common vulnerabilities and exposures for Ubuntu Linux as well as driving active hardening in the kernel

- Architecting enhancements to performance and correctness to make Ubuntu Linux the most reliable and highest performing Linux kernel available today

- Streamlining the packaging and distribution of particularly troublesome third-party components for optimal experience by end users

- Developing new means to deliver Ubuntu Linux at scale to the strict quality standards and delivery schedules expected by end users

While not a formal managerial role, the successful candidate will possess strong people skills and natural ability to lead engineers within the team, as well as working with other external teams to coordinate adoption and delivery.

We are looking for individuals with not only an incredibly deep technical background in operating system kernels and distributions, but also a strong flair for leadership and taking initiative to drive ideas and the associated delivery teams to completion.

While we hesitate to put a specific number of years of experience as a requirement for an applicant as that does not take into account relative ability or circumstances, for a comparative guideline we would be seeking candidates with the demonstrated technical equivalent of 15+ years of industry experience.

Location: We have home-based lead kernel engineer roles in every timezone, although the individual aspects as listed above may be linked to a specific geographic region.

What the role entails 

- Set the technical direction and lead the delivery of a team of junior and mid-career engineers for a key aspect of Ubuntu Linux

- Work closely with management within and outside the team to track and coordinate initiatives to delivery

- Collaborate daily with other senior technical leadership on the Kernel Team on how best to ensure Ubuntu stays at the pinnacle of Linux distributions

What we are looking for in you 

- Well-organised and motivated self-starter able to thrive in a remote work environment

- Strong communication skills in English, both written and verbal

- Expert understanding of the C programming language

- Demonstrated expertise working in a *nix-based operating system kernel and distribution. While direct Linux experience would be ideal, it is not required.

- Python and Bash scripting ability

- Powerful grasp of the capabilities and nuances of the git version control system

- Prior experience developing with software packaging formats, with direct Ubuntu/Debian/Snap experience being highly regarded

- Ability to travel internationally at least twice a year for company events of up to two weeks length

Nice-to-have skills 

- Strong background in RTOS and real-time performance analysis

- Demonstrated experience with kernel patching and debugging

- Strong grasp of device drivers, BSP’s, and other low level system engineering

- Prior experience with Rust, ideally as it pertains to the Linux kernel

What we offer colleagues 

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

- Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

- Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

- Annual compensation review

- Recognition rewards

- Annual holiday leave

- Maternity and paternity leave

- Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform

- Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
